name: India
title: India add-on: rheumatic heart disease and tuberculosis
description: Two presentations that matter in India and are absent from the base corpus. Layered on corpus-base, which supplies everything else.
emergency_note: The emergency number in this region is 108. Chunks in the base corpus are US sources and say 9-1-1. They are shown as they are, annotated, never edited or suppressed: hiding an inconsistency in a cited source is worse than showing it.
